environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound TCP 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or request filtering. ALB access logs enabled but no active monitoring. The Flask app runs via gunicorn with 4 workers, serving HTTPS traffic terminated at the ALB.
